info.title: drymem
info.description:
drymem's memory engine.

The knowledge graph, the extractor, the scrubber and the distiller. It is
reached only through the control plane, which authenticates the caller and
passes a signed assertion of who they are; nothing here faces the internet.

post.description: Save a session summary. Returns 422 if it contains a private key.

patch.description:
Append to a topic, or replace it.

Appending is the default because Graphiti reconciles contradictions itself:
the older fact is marked superseded rather than lost, which keeps the history
of a decision readable.

get.description: Every topic key already stored. Used by `drymem import` to stay idempotent.

delete.description: Delete a memory. A uuid outside the caller's org is simply not found.

post.description:
Record whether a retrieved memory was useful.

This is the pilot's precision metric: PLAN.md's 90% bar is measured from
these rows, so the query that surfaced the memory is stored alongside the
thumb — a rating with no query cannot be learned from.

Share a memory with the project's members.

Only your own memory, and only into a project you belong to. Promoting an
already-promoted memory succeeds without duplicating it, so a retry is safe.

get.description:
Subjects the team's memories keep returning to.

Which of them lack a skill is decided by the client, which is the only side
that knows what is installed on this machine.

post.description:
Draft a SKILL.md from the memories about a subject.

The result is a draft for a person to review, never something installed
automatically: a skill changes how every agent on the team behaves.

get.description:
What a well-written memory looks like.

Served rather than duplicated in each client: the UI, the CLI and any future
editor plugin all need the same list, and three hand-copied lists drift.
The sittings this project's memories came out of.

The knowledge graph, as nodes and edges.

Restricted to the caller's readable groups, so a private memory is never a
node on somebody else's canvas. Layout belongs to the browser.

get.description:
The decision tree: what was decided about each part of the codebase.

Restricted to the caller's readable groups, like the canvas beside it.

post.description:
Answer a question from this project's memories, with citations.

Every claim points at a memory or is not made. When nothing matches, the
answer says so rather than inventing one that reads like a fact.

get.description: What the hooks should do at the end of a session. See PLAN.md D38.
Liveness for both stores. Unauthenticated on purpose — it reveals nothing.

grounded.title: Grounded
grounded.description: False when nothing was found and no model was asked

query.title: Query
query.description: The search that surfaced this memory. A rating without it says 'this memory is bad'; with it, 'this memory is a bad answer to X'.

MemorySchemaResponse.title: MemorySchemaResponse
MemorySchemaResponse.description: The shape a well-written memory has. Served so clients need no copy of it.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Markdown body written by the agent

type.title: Type
type.description: decision · architecture · bugfix · discovery · convention · note. An unknown value becomes 'note' rather than failing the save.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: The agent run this came out of

scrubbed.title: Scrubbed
scrubbed.description: What was redacted, empty if nothing

degraded.title: Degraded
degraded.description: Set when extraction failed and only the episode was stored

synthetic.title: Synthetic
synthetic.description: Grouped by author and day because no session id was recorded

replace.title: Replace
replace.description: Delete prior episodes for this topic first
